OrgVaultChanges.description: A count of the changes to an org vault's entries.

OrgVaultChangesParam.description: The changes a host read last, in a query string.

OrgVaultEntryKind.description: What an entry of an org's vault is, such as model-key. The server sees this and nothing else of it.

OrgVaultWrapped.description: The org's key sealed for one host, in URL-safe base64.

OrgWrappedKey.description: The org's key, sealed for one member's host.

OrgVaultEntry.description: One entry in an org's vault, sealed under the org's key of its generation.

OrgVaultEnded.description: An entry removed from an org's vault, one revision above the last it had.

OrgVaultHolder.description: A member's computer that holds the org's key and would seal it for the asking host.

computer.description: The computer's name, as its account named it.

member.description: The name of the member it is on, as their sign-in names them. Null when the name cannot be told. Never an email address.

role.description: The role in the org of the account it is on.

yours.description: It is on the asking host's own account.

online.description: It is connected to the accounts server now.

lastSeenAt.description: When it last connected to the accounts server or left it, or null if it never has.

OrgVaultHost.description: A member's host and the membership its account has in the org.

computer.description: The computer's name, as its account named it. Only for the asking host's own account's, and for every host to an owner's or admin's.

OrgVaultIntroduction.description: The hosts the signing host trusts, sealed for the host it lets in and bound to the code that host showed, in URL-safe base64.

OrgVaultApprovedOnly.description: The asking host seals the key only for hosts a person let in. A host that does not say so is refused.

OrgVaultVouchPut.description: A host that holds the org's key says it trusts another member's host with it.

at.description: When it was signed, in milliseconds since 1970 by the signing host's clock.

signature.description: The signing host's Ed25519 signature, in URL-safe base64, over the org, both hosts, the membership of each and the time.

OrgVaultVouch.description: What one member's host signed of another, kept after the signer leaves. Hosts seal the org's key only for hosts they let in themselves or reach through these, and check each signature: the server only passes them on.

member.description: The membership hostKey's account had when it was signed, and has now.

byMember.description: The membership by's account had when it was signed. It may have left since.

at.description: When it was signed, in milliseconds since 1970 by the signing host's clock.

signature.description: The signing host's Ed25519 signature, in URL-safe base64, over the org, both hosts, the membership of each and the time.

OrgVault.description: An org's vault, as one of its members' hosts sees it.

key.description: The org's key sealed for the asking host at the current generation, or null when it has none yet.

holders.description: The members' hosts holding the key at the current generation.

waiting.description: The members' hosts without the key at the current generation, for a holder to wrap it for.

rotate.description: A host that held the key is no longer a member's host, so an owner's or admin's host should replace it.

holding.description: For an owner's or admin's host that cannot open the key, each other computer that holds it at the current generation and would seal it for that host (its own account's, and owners' and admins'), and when each was last online, so they can tell one that is asleep from one that is gone before making the vault again. Absent when the host has the key sealed by itself or by a current holder, and for any other member's host.

remadeAt.description: When an owner's or admin's host last made the vault again, or null if none has.

ended.description: Entries removed from the vault, each one revision above its last. A new entry under one of these ids is added at that revision; a write at the old one is refused.

changes.description: How many changes the vault's entries have had. A host passes it back as after to read only the entries changed or removed since.

since.description: The after this answer starts from: entries and ended hold only what changed since then. Null when they hold everything.

hosts.description: Every host in holders and waiting, with its membership.

vouches.description: What the members' hosts signed of each other.

vault.description: Null until an owner's or admin's host makes the vault.

OrgVaultCreate.description: An owner's or admin's host makes the org's vault, holding its key at generation 1.

key.description: The org's key sealed for the asking host.

OrgVaultRotate.description: An owner's or admin's host replaces the org's key: every wrap and every entry moves to the next generation at once.

keys.description: The new key sealed for each member's host that keeps it, the asking host among them. One for a host that neither held the key nor was vouched for is left out. Every other wrap is dropped.

entries.description: Every entry in the vault but those in drops, each once.

drops.description: A shared project's entries that do not open on the asking host, removed from the vault at the revision given.

vouches.description: What the asking host signed of the hosts it lets in with this, added first.

OrgVaultRemake.description: An owner's or admin's host whose computer cannot open the org's vault makes it again: every entry and every wrap is dropped, and the generation goes up with a new key held by the asking host alone.

key.description: The new key sealed for the asking host at the next generation.

OrgVaultKeysAdd.description: A member's host holding the org's key at the current generation seals it for other members' hosts: an owner's or admin's host for any, any other member's only for its own account's. A host that already has the key sealed for it keeps that one. One for a host that no host vouched for is left out.

vouches.description: What the asking host signed of the hosts it lets in with this, added first.

OrgVaultVouches.description: A host that holds the org's key adds what it signed of other members' hosts: an owner's or admin's host of any, any other member's only of its own account's and of a host that vouched for it. Each replaces what it signed of that host before, though an introduction stays until another comes. One it may not sign is left out.

OrgVaultEntryRead.description: An entry at the revision a writer read it.

OrgVaultEntryPut.description: An owner's or admin's host adds or replaces an entry. Any member's host may put a shared project's waiting list, and its store while the org lets every member add rules.

generation.description: The generation of the key it is sealed under, which must be current.

revision.description: The entry's revision as the writer last saw it, or 0 to add it.

checked.description: Other entries the writer read this one against, each at the revision it read: the write is refused as a conflict once any of them has moved.
